# NetsDial – Russea™ HDPE Net Wholesale Suppliers | GCM Enterprises

> NetsDial is India's largest wholesale supplier and dealer of **Russea™** branded HDPE safety nets, pigeon nets, bird control nets, cricket practice nets, invisible grills, artificial grass, and complete sports ground setup services. Founded in 2013, managed by **GCM Enterprises**, headquartered in Karmanghat, Hyderabad, Telangana, India. We serve customers, contractors, and dealers PAN India across all 28 states and 8 Union Territories.

## What We Do

### 1. Safety & Bird Control Nets (Sales, Supply & Installation)
- Pigeon Netting for balconies, windows, terrace, shafts, ducts
- Bird Netting for commercial buildings, warehouses, solar panels
- Anti-Bird Nets (HDPE Braided, Twisted, Knotted)
- Balcony Safety Nets for high-rise apartments
- Children Safety Nets (fall protection for toddlers and kids)
- Pigeon Spikes (SS, Polycarbonate, Plastic variants)
- Anti-Bird Spikes for ledges, AC units, parapet walls
- Construction Safety Nets, Fall Protection Nets, Pet Safety Nets
- Industrial Bird Netting for factories and warehouses

### 2. Home Fittings & Protection (Sales, Supply & Installation)
- Invisible Grills (thin vertical SS wire system for balconies/windows)
- SS Invisible Grills (Grade 316 Stainless Steel)
- Cloth Hangers Installation (ceiling-mounted pulley system)
- SS Cloth Hangers (wall-mounted stainless steel rails)
- Coconut Safety Nets, Monkey Safety Nets, Debris Nets

### 3. Sports & Recreation (Complete Ground Setup – Planning → Supply → Installation → Handover)
- Artificial Grass installation (25mm, 30mm, 40mm, 50mm – Single & Double layer)
- Artificial Turf for sports grounds
- Cricket Ground Pitch Turf (professional artificial pitch)
- Cricket Practice Nets (HDPE 40mm, 45mm, 50mm mesh)
- Box Cricket Net Setup (full cage, open-top, rooftop, indoor)
- Box Cricket Complete Ground Setup (net + grass + structure + flooring)
- Sports Practice Nets (multi-sport)
- Football Turf Ground Construction (5-a-side, 6-a-side, 7-a-side, 9-a-side, 11-a-side)
- Football Goal Post Nets, Volleyball Court Nets

## Products – Russea™ Brand

- **Material**: HDPE (High-Density Polyethylene)
- **Types**: Braided HDPE Nets, Twisted HDPE Nets, Knotted HDPE Nets
- **UV Stabilized**: Yes – suitable for outdoor, all-weather use
- **Mesh Sizes**: 30mm, 40mm, 45mm, 50mm square gap
- **Thickness**: 1.5mm, 2mm, 2.5mm, 3mm
- **Colors**: Black, White, Green, Custom
- **Certifications**: Russea™ Trademark verified HDPE nets

## Pricing (Approximate – Confirm by calling)

### Balcony Safety Nets / Pigeon Nets
- Below 100 sq ft: ₹1,500–₹1,800 (flat rate, with installation)
- 100–250 sq ft: ₹16–₹30 per sq ft (depending on thickness)
- 250–500 sq ft: ₹14–₹26 per sq ft
- 500–1,000 sq ft: ₹12–₹24 per sq ft
- 1,000–5,000 sq ft: ₹10–₹20 per sq ft
- Above 5,000 sq ft: Call for best price

### Cricket Practice Nets
- 1,000–5,000 sq ft: ₹13–₹18 per sq ft
- 5,000–10,000 sq ft: ₹12–₹17 per sq ft
- 10,000–15,000 sq ft: ₹10–₹15 per sq ft
- Above 20,000 sq ft: ₹8–₹12 per sq ft

### Invisible Grills
- 1.5mm wire: ₹120–₹150 per sq ft
- 2mm wire: ₹130–₹160 per sq ft
- 2.5mm wire: ₹140–₹170 per sq ft
- 3mm wire: ₹150–₹180 per sq ft

### Artificial Grass Mats
- 25mm Single Layer: ₹30–₹40 per sq ft
- 50mm Double Layer: ₹45–₹55 per sq ft
- Football Grass (50mm Double): ₹75–₹100 per sq ft
- Sports Turf (25mm): ₹95–₹135 per sq ft

### Box Cricket Ground Setup (complete – net + grass + structure + flooring)
- ₹220–₹300 per sq ft (based on height: 20ft, 25ft, 30ft, 35ft, 40ft)

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is NetsDial?**
A: NetsDial is India's largest Russea™ HDPE net wholesale supplier managed by GCM Enterprises, based in Hyderabad, supplying safety nets, pigeon nets, cricket nets, and sports setup services PAN India since 2013.

**Q: What nets does NetsDial supply?**
A: We supply Russea™ brand HDPE Braided, Twisted, and Knotted nets in all sizes – pigeon nets, balcony safety nets, bird control nets, cricket practice nets, sports nets, construction safety nets, and more.

**Q: Does NetsDial install nets?**
A: Yes. NetsDial provides sales, supply, and installation services for all net products. For sports grounds, we provide complete setup from planning to handover.

**Q: How much does pigeon net cost in Hyderabad?**
A: Below 100 sq ft costs ₹1,500 flat. For 100–250 sq ft, prices range from ₹16–₹30 per sq ft depending on thickness and mesh size.

**Q: Does NetsDial serve cities outside Hyderabad?**
A: Yes. We supply PAN India – all 28 states and 8 Union Territories. We are dealers and installation partners across Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, Delhi NCR, and all other states.

**Q: What is the Russea™ brand?**
A: Russea™ is a registered trademark HDPE net brand. All nets supplied by NetsDial are made from high-quality UV-stabilized HDPE material under the Russea™ brand.

**Q: How do I contact NetsDial?**
A: Call or WhatsApp +91 9966499144. Email: contact@netsdial.com. Visit: Karmanghat, Hyderabad, Telangana 500035.
